# Load in all necessary packages
```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(sesame)
library(sesameData)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Query, Download, and Prepare the data.
```{r}
query <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-BRCA",
                  data.category = "DNA Methylation",
                  data.type = "Methylation Beta Value",
                  platform = "Illumina Human Methylation 450",
                  data.format = "Dataframe")
GDCdownload(query)
methylation450 <- GDCprepare(query)
```
The above data requires a LOT of memory. My recommendation: GDCdownload() and GDCprepare() in separate R sessions.
R requires a lot of memory for both.

```{r}
methylation_clinical <- as.data.frame(methylation450@colData)
betas <- as.data.frame(methylation450@assays@data@listData) #takes a longer time
cpg_sites <- as.data.frame(methylation450@rowRanges@elementMetadata)

column_mask <- ifelse(colnames(methylation_clinical) %in% c('treatments', 'primary_site', 'disease_type','sites_of_involvement'), F, T)

methylation_clinical <- methylation_clinical[,column_mask]
write.csv(methylation_clinical, 'brca_methylation_clinical.csv')


site_mask <- !grepl('-', cpg_sites$gene) & !grepl(';', cpg_sites$gene) & !is.na(cpg_sites$gene) & complete.cases(betas)
betas <- betas[site_mask,]
cpg_sites <- cpg_sites[site_mask,]

write.csv(betas, 'brca_methylation_betas.csv') #takes a longer time
write.csv(cpg_sites, 'brca_cpg_sites.csv')
```

Use the code below if you are loading in your data (i.e. you downloaded the data and closed the session, but you are back to continue working)

# (1) Naive Differential Methylation
```{r}
# only metastatic and primary solid tumor patients
clinical_df <- as.data.frame(methylation_clinical)

sample_mask <- !is.na(clinical_df$definition) &
  clinical_df$definition %in%
  c("Metastatic", "Primary solid Tumor")

methylation_clinical <- clinical_df[sample_mask, , drop = FALSE]
betas_clean <- betas[, sample_mask, drop = FALSE]

# Define comparison groups
methylation_clinical$metastatic <- factor(
  methylation_clinical$definition,
  levels = c("Primary solid Tumor", "Metastatic")
)

# Convert beta values into M-values
betas_safe <- pmin(pmax(betas_clean, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6)
mval <- log2(betas_safe / (1 - betas_safe))

# Fit linear models comparing metastatic vs non-metastatic
design <- model.matrix(~ metastatic, data = methylation_clinical)
fit <- lmFit(mval, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit)
```

```{r}
# Extracting model into dataframe
dat <- data.frame(foldchange = fit[["coefficients"]][,2], logPvalue =  -log10(p.adjust(fit2[["p.value"]][,2],method='BY')), geneName = cpg_sites$gene)
dat$threshold <- as.factor(abs(dat$foldchange) < 1)

# Visualization
cols <- c("TRUE" = "grey", "FALSE" = "blue")
ggplot(data=dat, aes(x=foldchange, y = logPvalue)) +
  geom_point(alpha=.2, size=0.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour="#990000", linetype="dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = - 1, colour="#990000", linetype="dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, colour = "#990000", linetype="dashed") +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  xlab("Fold Change") +
  ylab("-log10 p value") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Saving results to a .csv file
write.csv(dat, "methylation_results_age.csv")
```

#(2) Direct comparison of methylation status to transcriptional activity
...INSERT DESeq2 Stuff here to generate 'results'...

```{r}

library(DESeq2)
rna_clinical <- read.csv("brca_rna_clinical_data.csv", row.names = 1)
rna_genes <- read.csv("brca_rna_gene_data.csv")
rna_counts <- read.csv("brca_rna_count_data.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)


sample_mask <- !is.na(rna_clinical$definition) &
  rna_clinical$definition %in%
  c("Primary solid Tumor", "Metastatic")

rna_clinical <- rna_clinical[sample_mask, , drop = FALSE]

# Match sample order between clinical data and count data
common_samples <- intersect(rownames(rna_clinical), colnames(rna_counts))

rna_clinical <- rna_clinical[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
rna_counts <- rna_counts[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
rna_clinical$definition <- factor(
  rna_clinical$definition,
  levels = c("Primary solid Tumor", "Metastatic")
)

# Create DESeq2 dataset
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(as.matrix(rna_counts)),
  colData = rna_clinical,
  design = ~ definition
)

# preprocess by removing genes with very low counts
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10, ]

# Run differential expression analysis
dds <- DESeq(dds)
results <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = c("definition", "Metastatic", "Primary solid Tumor")
)

# Convert results to dataframe
de_results <- as.data.frame(results)

# Save gene IDs as a column
de_results$gene_id <- rownames(de_results)

# Save results
write.csv(de_results, "deSeq_results_age.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
de_results <- read.csv("deSeq_results_age.csv")

rna_clinical <- read.csv("brca_rna_clinical_data.csv", row.names = 1)
rna_genes <- read.csv("brca_rna_gene_data.csv")
rna_counts <- read.csv("brca_rna_count_data.csv", row.names = 1)

```


```{r}

# Extract genes of interest

# Downregulated genes in metastatic patients
downregulated <- de_results[
  !is.na(de_results$padj) &
  de_results$padj < 0.05 &
  de_results$log2FoldChange < -1,
  "gene_name"
]

# Hypermethylated genes in metastatic patients
hypermethylated <- dat[
  dat$foldchange > 1 &
  dat$logPvalue > -log10(0.05),
  "geneName"
]

# Find genes in both groups
interest_genes <- intersect(downregulated, hypermethylated)

print(interest_genes)
```

```{r}
# Explore your gene of interest
GENE<-"DNAH10"

gene_counts_mask <- rna_genes$gene_name == GENE
gene_betas_mask <- cpg_sites$gene == GENE

#What are we doing here? define groups
rna_primary <- rna_clinical$definition == "Primary solid Tumor"
rna_metastatic <- rna_clinical$definition == "Metastatic"

methylation_primary <- methylation_clinical$definition == "Primary solid Tumor"
methylation_metastatic <- methylation_clinical$definition == "Metastatic"

# Extract RNA counts
rna_primary_counts <- as.numeric(
  as.matrix(rna_counts[gene_counts_mask, rna_primary, drop = FALSE])
)

rna_metastatic_counts <- as.numeric(
  as.matrix(rna_counts[gene_counts_mask, rna_metastatic, drop = FALSE])
)

# Extract methylation beta values
methylation_primary_betas <- as.matrix(
  betas[gene_betas_mask, methylation_primary, drop = FALSE]
)

methylation_metastatic_betas <- as.matrix(
  betas[gene_betas_mask, methylation_metastatic, drop = FALSE]
)

# Check dimensions
dim(methylation_primary_betas)
dim(methylation_metastatic_betas)
```

```{r}
# Show transcriptional differences
boxplot(
  rna_primary_counts,
  rna_metastatic_counts,
  xlab = "Group",
  ylab = "RNA Counts",
  names = c("Primary", "Metastatic"),
  col = c("blue", "red")
)
```

```{r}
# Show methylation differences at CpG sites in this gene 
primary_means <- rowMeans(methylation_primary_betas, na.rm = TRUE)
metastatic_means <- rowMeans(methylation_metastatic_betas, na.rm = TRUE)

# Check that values exist
print(length(primary_means))
print(length(metastatic_means))

# Plot methylation differences
plot(
  seq_along(primary_means),
  primary_means,
  col = "blue",
  type = "h",
  lwd = 3,
  ylim = c(0, 1),
  ylab = "Average Beta",
  xlab = "CpG Sites"
)

lines(
  seq_along(metastatic_means) + 0.3,
  metastatic_means,
  col = "red",
  type = "h",
  lwd = 3
)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("Primary", "Metastatic"),
  col = c("blue", "red"),
  lwd = 3,
  cex = 0.7
)
```
